headline: Executive order recognizes steps taken by Sudan's government and sets up the removal of some US sanctions on Sudan.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Obama, recognizes what it calls positive actions by the government of Sudan. It provides for revoking certain US sanctions related to Sudan. No summary was available, so the specific sanctions, conditions, and details are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: US businesses and individuals who trade with or invest in Sudan
who_it_affects.how: Some US rules that limit doing business with Sudan may be lifted, depending on which sanctions the order covers.
Some US sanctions aimed at Sudan are set to be removed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 13, 2017; the title does not say exactly when the sanctions are removed.
